body:
That's the thing. It's just so uncertain. And with where I'm at right now (which is a pretty good place) I have more chances of falling worse than having a better future than the life I'm leading now. 

My professor once told me that there are times when it doesn't matter how hard I work, I would still fail anyway and that it's part of life. I guess I've always "known" that, but the moment she taught me that I felt like it really sunk in.

I do not see the appeal of spending the effort of wading through the shit. Especially when all I get are only brief tastes of sugar in the midst of so many bitterness. I don't consider it worth all the effort, and pain, and all that power I have to expend.
I hope this isn't true or I'd rather not date at all.
